Messages.Body:
If one of your minions has just committed Diablerie and you are pretty
sure that a blood hunt will be called to burn that minion, are you
allowed to skip the step where you shuffle through your library for a
discipline master card to place on the minion in order to save it for
some other use?

Peter Oh

Sent via Deja.com
http://www.deja.com/

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
In article <954vph$pi1$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,
tr0i...@my-deja.com wrote:
> If one of your minions has just committed Diablerie, are you

> allowed to skip the step where you shuffle through your library for a
> discipline master card to place on the minion in order to save it for
> some other use?

Yes.

See 6.5.5.4 (page 47) of the Sabbat War Rulebook.

"the diablerist can be given a Discipline"

Notice that gaining a Discipline is optional.
You do not have to give the vampire a Discipline.
